situation: I'm Mateo. Told my manager Priya in person this morning that I'm leaving for a job at a fintech startup; last day Friday 30 October. Need to send the formal notice email now. Been there 4 years, and she pushed me to lead the billing migration when I wasn't sure I was ready.
reply:
Hi Priya,
Following our conversation this morning, this is my formal notice of resignation. My last day will be Friday 30 October. Thank you for the past four years, and especially for pushing me to lead the billing migration when I wasn't sure I was ready. I'll have the handover doc to you by Friday and will make sure nothing drops before I go.
Best,
Mateo
note: The written note is a record, not the conversation: date, one specific thanks, the handover.

situation: 我在一个读书会当了两年组织者，现在工作太忙想退出，想在群里说一声。11月15号那场活动的场地是我订的，想办完这场再交接。
reply: 各位书友，想跟大家说一声：11月15号那场活动办完后，我就不再担任读书会的组织者了。这两年跟大家一起读书特别开心，只是最近工作实在排不开，不想因为我拖了大家的节奏。那场的场地我已经订好，会办完再交接，也很乐意帮下一任组织者熟悉流程。谢谢大家！
note: 给出明确日期，说清收尾和交接，理由一句就够，不多解释。

situation: I resigned from my marketing job, my boss Greg offered me a 15% raise to stay. I've already signed with the new company. How do I say no without him getting weird for my last 3 weeks?
reply: I appreciate that, Greg, genuinely, and it means a lot that you'd make that offer. I've made my decision and I'd like to keep it clean. What I'd like is to make these three weeks as useful as possible, so tell me what you most want nailed down in the handover and I'll start there.
note: Hold the decision, don't re-argue the reason, and turn straight to the handover.

situation: I'm Dev. I've done the books for Ferro's, a family bakery, on a $600/month retainer for five years, and the owner Carla brings me focaccia every Friday. I'm starting a full-time job in January and need to end it. I called her yesterday, now I want to put it in writing.
reply:
Hi Carla,
Thanks for taking my call yesterday. To confirm in writing: I'll be ending our bookkeeping arrangement, and December will be my last month. I'll close out the year-end accounts before I go, write up a handover for whoever takes over, and I'm happy to spend an hour with them in person. If it helps, I can recommend two bookkeepers I'd trust with Ferro's. Thank you for five really good years, and for all the Friday focaccia.
Best,
Dev
note: Ending a client relationship follows the same shape as a resignation: tell them by phone, then a written note with the date, a real handover and a specific thanks.

situation: I gave notice yesterday, last day is Friday Oct 23. My manager Dave just replied on Slack: 'Honestly didn't expect this from you, leaving right before the Q4 launch really puts us in a hole.' I've been there 3 years, and my colleague Leila will take over the launch checklist and vendor contacts.
reply: I understand the timing is hard, Dave, and I'm sorry it lands right before the launch. My decision is made and my last day stays Friday 23 October. I want these weeks to be useful, so I've started a handover doc for the launch checklist and can walk Leila through the vendor contacts on Thursday. Tell me what you'd most like prioritised and I'll start there.
note: After a guilt-trip, hold the date, don't re-argue the reason, and turn the conversation into a handover question.

situation: I started at a logistics startup in June and I'm quitting after 4 months; my contract says two weeks' notice. The role turned out to be mostly sales, which isn't what I signed up for. My manager Beth has been kind, and I have 23 open accounts plus the Harlow onboarding to hand over. Meeting her tomorrow, what do I say?
reply: Beth, I wanted to tell you in person: I've decided to leave, and I'm giving my two weeks' notice today, so my last day would be Wednesday 14 October. The role has turned out to be different from what I'm looking for, and I'd rather say that early than let it drag. Before I go I'll write up the status of all 23 open accounts and hand over the Harlow onboarding properly. Thank you for all the time you've put into getting me started.
note: A short tenure needs less explanation, not more: one honest line about fit, a clear date that matches your contract's notice, a concrete handover, no apology tour.

situation: 大学3年生で、駅前のカフェで2年間アルバイトをしている。レジと閉店作業を担当していて、就活に集中したいので11月末で辞めたい。店長の佐藤さんには一から仕事を教えてもらった。明日のシフト後に直接話すつもりだけど、何と言えばいい？
reply: 佐藤さん、少しお時間よろしいですか。就職活動に集中するため、11月30日の勤務を最後に辞めさせていただきたいと思っています。早めにお伝えしたくて、今日お話ししました。それまでのシフトはこれまで通り入りますし、新しい方が入ったら、レジと閉店作業は私がお教えします。2年間、一から教えてくださって、本当にありがとうございました。
note: アルバイトでも退職の形は同じ：直接伝え、最初に日付、理由は一言、具体的な引き継ぎ、具体的な感謝。

situation: Je suis Sophie, quatre ans chez Atelier Nova. Mon dernier jour est vendredi 9 octobre, ma manager le sait, et Camille reprend mes dossiers. Je veux envoyer un mot d'au revoir à l'équipe par mail ; j'ai surtout appris sur le lancement de l'appli l'an dernier.
reply:
Bonjour à tous,
Vendredi 9 octobre sera mon dernier jour chez Atelier Nova. Merci pour ces quatre années, et en particulier pour le lancement de l'appli l'an dernier, où j'ai énormément appris. Mes dossiers sont repris par Camille, qui a tout en main. Vous pouvez me joindre sur LinkedIn, et je serais ravie de garder le contact. À très vite, j'espère.
Sophie
note: Le mot à l'équipe vient après la manager : la date, un merci précis, qui reprend vos dossiers et comment vous joindre. Ni raisons, ni règlements de comptes.

situation: 我大学毕业后在我爸的五金厂帮忙管账，已经三年了，跟着他学会了怎么跟老客户打交道。我想去深圳做设计，年底离开，厂里的会计小陈可以接手。我爸一直希望我以后接班，打算周末吃饭时当面跟他说。
reply: 爸，想跟您认真说件事：我决定年底离开厂里，12月31日是我最后一天。我想去深圳做设计，这是我一直想试的事，趁年轻去拼一拼。这三个月我会把账目理清楚，把会计小陈带出来，工资表和供应商对账都做成模板，尽量让厂里交接顺顺当当。这三年跟着您，学得最多的是怎么跟老客户打交道，这个我会一直带着。
note: 对家人也是同一个结构：当面说，先说决定和日期，理由一句，交接具体，最后是具体的感谢；接班的事不在这次辩论。

situation: I play bass in a covers band with three friends, Sam, Ollie and Kate. We gig about once a month. Our baby is due in December and I can't keep doing weekly rehearsals. I want to leave after our Halloween gig on Oct 31 without letting them down.
reply: Guys, I'd rather tell you now than fade out: with the baby due in December I can't keep up with rehearsals, so the Halloween gig on the 31st will be my last. I'll have the new set properly learned for it, and I'm happy to sit in with whoever you try out and pass on all my charts. I've loved every minute of this band, and I'll be front row at your next gig.
note: Leaving a shared commitment with friends: a clear last date, a real handover, and warmth without over-explaining.

situation: I'm Paul, treasurer of our neighborhood association for two years; the term runs to next June and the insurance renewal is due in January. A new job means I can't keep doing it. I want to step down at the Nov 10 meeting and tell the chair, Linda, before the rest of the board.
reply:
Hi Linda, I wanted you to hear this from me before the rest of the board: I'm going to step down as treasurer at the Tuesday Nov 10 meeting. I've started a new job and can't give the books the attention they need, so I'd rather hand over cleanly than let things slip. Before then I'll reconcile the accounts through October and write up the bank access steps, vendor list and the insurance renewal due in January. I'm happy to spend two evenings with whoever takes over. Thank you for two good years.
Paul
note: Chair first, a fixed date, one line of reason and a handover concrete enough that nobody has to chase you.

situation: 我在一家私教工作室跟李教练练了两年，深蹲从空杆练到了80公斤。现在想换到公司楼下的健身房自己练，省时间也省钱。课包还剩3节，想上完就结束，但不知道怎么开口。
reply: 李教练，跟你说一声：剩下这三节上完，我就先不续课了。公司楼下开了健身房，我想试试自己练，时间上方便很多。这两年你帮我把深蹲从空杆练到80公斤，真的很感谢。最后三节能不能帮我排一个我自己照着练的计划？
note: 结束服务关系：一句话说决定，理由一句就够，具体地感谢，再提一个让最后几次课有用的请求。

situation: 我在一个校友创业交流群里待了两年，每天几百条消息，想退群。群主是我读研时的导师王老师，怕直接退了显得不礼貌。我已经私下跟王老师说过了。
reply: 各位，我先退出这个群啦，最近消息实在跟不上，老是错过重要的信息。谢谢王老师当初拉我进来，这两年在群里认识了不少好朋友。有事随时私信我，我都在。
note: 退群也是离开：先私下告诉最在意的人，再在群里发一句简短温和的告别，不用解释太多。

situation: I'm resigning from my sales engineer job tomorrow, last day Friday Oct 30, and I look after six accounts. I'm going to a direct competitor and I'd rather not tell my manager Fiona where, at least until I've started. She taught me how to run a demo, and she will definitely ask.
reply: Fiona, I wanted to tell you directly: I've decided to leave, and I'm giving my notice today. My last day will be Friday 30 October. I'd rather keep where I'm going to myself for now; it's nothing to do with you, I just want the focus on leaving well. I've started a handover doc for my six accounts and I'd like to walk you through it this week. You taught me how to run a demo, and I'm grateful for that.
note: Declining to say where is fine: say it once, kindly, never invent a cover story, and check your contract for notice or non-compete terms before the meeting.

situation: I manage a team of five designers and my last day is Friday Oct 30. HR's exit form asks for honest feedback, and the main reason I'm leaving is that we've been two designers short since March and I've covered the gap with evenings. I want to say it without sounding bitter.
reply: Thank you for asking. The main factor in my decision was workload: the team has been two designers short since March, and I've been covering the gap in the evenings. I'd suggest filling both roles before my successor starts, so they don't inherit the same gap. I've valued leading this team, and I'm grateful for the chance to do it.
note: Exit feedback stays factual: one cause, one concrete suggestion, no blame on named people, and a closing line that leaves the bridge intact.

situation: Comparto piso en Madrid con tres amigas desde hace dos años. Me voy a vivir con mi pareja, Dani, y el contrato dice que hay que avisar con un mes, así que quiero irme el 31 de octubre. Mi prima Lucía busca habitación y le encantaría quedarse con la mía.
reply: Chicas, os quería contar algo antes de que os llegue por otro lado: me voy a vivir con Dani, así que el 31 de octubre será mi último día en el piso. Os lo digo hoy para cumplir el mes de preaviso del contrato. Mi prima Lucía busca habitación y le encantaría quedarse con la mía; si os parece, la traigo a cenar esta semana para que la conozcáis, y si preferís a otra persona, os ayudo a buscarla. Han sido dos años geniales con vosotras.
note: Dejar un piso compartido: fecha clara, el preaviso que marca el contrato y ayuda real para cubrir la habitación, sin decidir por ellas.

situation: Two friends, Ana and Priya, and I have run a weekend market stall selling our screen-printed tees for two years, and I do all the printing. I want to stop after the Christmas market on Dec 19 and I'm telling them in our group chat tonight. There's about £1,800 in the shared account, plus stock and the screens we paid for together.
reply: I need to be honest with you both: I want to step back from the stall after the Christmas market on Dec 19, and I'd rather say it now than let it drift. I'll do all the printing for the Christmas market, and before I stop I'd like to show you both the printing setup properly so you can carry on if you want to. On the £1,800, the stock and the screens, let's sit down after the market and split it in a way that feels fair to all three of us. These two years with you have been so much fun, and I'm sorry to be the one stepping away.
note: Early notice, a full handover of the one job only you do, and the shared money settled face to face rather than in the chat.

situation: 我在李姐家做育儿嫂两年，带她女儿朵朵，朵朵现在4岁。我妈身体不好，我要回老家照顾她，想做到11月15日。李姐一家对我很好，我也很舍不得朵朵，打算今晚她下班后当面说。
reply: 李姐，有件事想跟您当面说：我妈身体不太好，我得回老家照顾她，想做到11月15日。提前一个半月跟您说，是想让您有时间慢慢找合适的人。这段时间我照常带朵朵，新阿姨来了我带她一起做几天，把朵朵的作息、爱吃的和午睡的习惯都交代清楚。这两年您一家对我特别好，我也真舍不得朵朵。
note: 家政工作也是同一个结构：当面说，日期放在前面，理由一句，交接具体到孩子的日常，最后是真心的感谢。

situation: I gave two weeks' notice, as my contract requires, and my last day is Friday Oct 16. My manager Ines now wants me to stay until Oct 30 to cover the year-end audit prep, but I start my new job on Monday Oct 19 and can't move it. My colleague Tom is taking over the audit, and I'd be fine doing two short evening calls the week after if he gets stuck.
reply: I understand the audit timing makes this hard, Ines, and I want to leave it in good shape. My last day stays Friday 16 October, because I start my new role on Monday the 19th and can't move it. Before I go I'll finish the audit prep folder and walk Tom through all of it, and if he gets stuck the week after, I'm happy to do two short evening calls with him. Which parts of the audit would you like me to cover first?
note: When asked to stay longer, hold the date, offer one bounded extra you actually want to give, and turn the talk to handover priorities.

situation: I'm in the second year of a PhD with Professor Okafor, funded on her research grant. I've accepted an industry data science job starting Monday Jan 11, so I'm leaving the programme. I'll finish my draft of our shared dataset paper by Friday Dec 18 and document the cleaning code for whoever takes it over. I'm telling her in our meeting tomorrow and sending an email afterwards.
reply:
Dear Professor Okafor,
Thank you for making time today. As I said, I've decided to leave the PhD programme and have accepted a data science role starting Monday 11 January. Before I go, I'll finish my draft of our dataset paper by Friday 18 December and document the cleaning code so whoever takes it over can pick it up easily. I've learned a great deal from you over these two years, and I'm grateful for the trust you showed in funding me on your grant. Could we agree a handover plan at our next meeting?
Best wishes
note: Tell a supervisor in person first, and check your funding terms for any notice or repayment conditions before you set a date.

situation: I'm quitting my job at a small design agency after 18 months, mainly because the founder, Mark, yells at people in meetings. I've accepted another role, my contract says four weeks' notice so my last day is Friday Oct 30, and I look after three client accounts. I'm telling him on a call tomorrow; he'll ask why and I don't want to get into it.
reply: Mark, I wanted to tell you directly: I've decided to leave, and I'm giving my four weeks' notice today, so my last day will be Friday 30 October. I've accepted another role, and it's time for a change. I'll write up handover notes for my three client accounts by the end of next week so nothing drops. Thank you for the last 18 months.
note: Leaving because of problems: no reason owed. If he presses, repeat 'it's time for a change'; keep any honest feedback for an exit interview, factual.

situation: For two years I've walked my elderly neighbour Mr. Patel's dog, Bruno, every weekday lunchtime, just as a favour. I start an office job on Monday 2 November, so my last walk will be Friday 30 October. Aisha, the 15-year-old next door, has said she'd happily take it on for pocket money, and I'm telling Mr. Patel in person tomorrow.
reply: Mr. Patel, I wanted to tell you myself: I'm starting an office job on Monday 2 November, so Friday 30 October will be my last lunchtime walk with Bruno. I've loved these two years with him. Aisha from next door has said she'd be happy to take over for a bit of pocket money; if you'd like, I'll bring her along on a few walks this month so Bruno gets to know her. And I'm just across the road, so I'll still pop in to say hello to him.
note: An unpaid favour still deserves a date and a handover; here the handover is the introduction.

situation: I'm Pat. I've rented a chair at Maureen's salon for 26 years, ever since she gave me my first chair when I'd just qualified, and I'm retiring; my last day will be Saturday 19 December. About 40 regulars book with me, and my colleague Tasha has said she'd love to take on any who want her. I'm telling Maureen tomorrow before I tell any clients.
reply: Maureen, I wanted you to hear it from me first: I'm retiring, and Saturday 19 December will be my last day in the chair. You gave me my first chair when I'd just qualified, and I've never forgotten it. I'll tell my regulars over the next few weeks, and Tasha has said she'd love to take on anyone who wants her, so I'll offer each of them an appointment with her before I go. Is there anything you'd like me to sort out before December?
note: Retiring follows the same shape: the person most affected first, a date, a handover that leaves clients a choice, and one specific thanks.

situation: I'm Ellie. My manager, Jo, is also one of my closest friends from university, and she hired me two years ago. I've accepted a job at another firm; my contract says four weeks' notice, so my last day would be Friday 30 October. I own the client onboarding process and I'm telling her over coffee tomorrow without wanting it to wreck the friendship.
reply: Jo, I wanted you to hear this from me, as my manager and as my friend: I've decided to leave, and I'm giving my four weeks' notice today, so my last day will be Friday 30 October. I've accepted a role at another firm. Before I go I'll write up the client onboarding process and walk whoever takes it over through it. You took a chance on me two years ago and I'm really grateful. Work aside, I'm not going anywhere as your friend.
note: When your manager is a friend, give the notice as a work conversation first; keep the friendship to one line and save the longer talk for outside work.

situation: 我在一家广告公司做了四年客户经理，8月底因为焦虑和失眠请了一个月病假，现在快到期了，我决定不回去了。合同写离职要提前30天书面通知；主管刘姐对我很好，去年手把手带我拿下了第一个年度大客户。我手上的三个客户已经由同事小吴临时接手，今天下午我先给刘姐打电话，再发书面通知，不想细说病情。
reply: 刘姐，谢谢您今天下午接我的电话。按电话里说的，这是我的正式辞职通知：按合同约定提前30天书面通知，我的劳动合同到2026年10月31日结束。出于健康原因，我决定不再回岗。三个客户现在由小吴接手，我会在10月9日周五前把客户资料和进行中的事项整理成交接文档，发给您和小吴，之后有问题也可以随时找我。这四年谢谢您，尤其是去年手把手带我拿下第一个年度大客户。
note: 健康原因一句就够，不必交代病情；病假期间离职的具体手续对照合同或问人事。情绪撑不住时，找医生或当地心理援助热线。

situation: 我和大学同学阿凯合开了一家宠物美容店，三年了，各占50%。我要回老家照顾爸妈，想年底退出，12月31日是最后一天；合伙协议里的退出条款约定由会计按账面评估股份，再由留下的一方回购。店里的进货和供应商一直是我在管，今晚当面跟他说了，想再发一条书面消息确认。
reply: 阿凯，谢谢你今晚愿意听我说完。按我们当面说的，正式跟你确认一下：我决定退出店里，12月31日是我最后一天，原因就是要回老家照顾爸妈。股份按合伙协议的退出条款来，请会计按账面评估后由你回购，具体怎么付我们再坐下来慢慢商量。进货和供应商一直是我在管，11月底前我会把供应商名单、价格和下单流程整理好，带你或者你找的人完整跑一遍。这三年跟你一起把店从零做起来，是我特别珍惜的一段日子。
note: 合伙退出：先当面说，再书面确认日期、协议里写好的回购方式、具体交接和具体感谢；股份怎么算以协议和会计为准，拿不准就问律师。

situation: I'm Ravi, and for five years I've co-maintained an open-source date-parsing library with Jun. I'm burned out and want my evenings back, so I'm stepping down as a maintainer on 31 October; I told Jun on a call yesterday and he'll keep leading it. Before then I'll review the 12 open PRs tagged for the v3.2 release and hand my admin rights to Jun. I want to post it in the project's GitHub Discussions.
reply:
Hi everyone, I'm stepping down as a maintainer on 31 October. After five years I need my evenings back, and I'd rather say so clearly than slowly go quiet. Before then I'll review the 12 open PRs tagged for v3.2 and hand my admin rights to Jun, who will keep leading the project. Thank you to everyone who has filed issues and sent fixes over the years. If you've ever thought about helping maintain, talk to Jun.
Ravi
note: A public exit from a volunteer project: co-maintainer first, then a date, a named successor and a concrete handover so nobody is left guessing.

situation: I've mentored Jayden, 15, through a youth mentoring programme for 18 months; we meet every other Saturday, he wants to study engineering, and I've really loved it. I'm moving to Glasgow for work in December, so our last session will be Saturday 28 November, and the coordinator, Sarah, will match him with a new mentor. I'm telling him in person at our session this Saturday.
reply: Jayden, I wanted you to hear this from me first: I'm moving to Glasgow for work in December, so Saturday 28 November will be our last session. It's nothing to do with you; I've really loved these 18 months. Sarah is going to match you with a new mentor, and before I go I'd like us to write down your engineering plans together so you can show them where you've got to. We've still got a few sessions left, so let's make them good ones.
note: Leaving someone who relies on you: tell them first and in person, say plainly it isn't about them, and make the handover something you do together.

situation: 我叫周宁，在一家检测公司做了三年工程师。去年部门经理赵总推荐我参加资格证培训，公司出了3万元，培训协议约定服务期两年，提前离职按未满月数比例返还，我还差8个月，算下来是1万元。我已经接了新offer，合同要求提前30天书面通知，今天上午当面跟赵总说了，最后工作日定在11月2日（周一），手上两个在测项目交给同事小孙，想发正式邮件。
reply:
赵总您好：
按今天上午当面沟通的，这是我的正式辞职通知。按劳动合同提前30天书面通知，我的最后工作日是11月2日（周一）。去年的资格证培训由公司出资3万元，培训协议约定服务期两年，我还差8个月，按协议比例我理解需返还1万元，具体金额和方式请人事按协议核算，我全力配合。手上两个在测项目，我会在10月16日（周五）前整理好交接文档，并带小孙把流程完整跑一遍。三年来谢谢您，尤其是当初推荐我去参加这次培训。
周宁
note: 离职带着培训费返还：主动写清自己对协议的理解，以协议原文和人事核算为准，拿不准就咨询律师。

situation: Canto há oito anos no coro da paróquia, com ensaios às quintas, e foi o maestro, o Sr. Joaquim, que me ensinou a ler partituras. Deixei de frequentar a igreja e quero sair sem entrar em conversas sobre fé. Quero que a missa de Todos os Santos, domingo 1 de novembro, seja a última, e a Rita disse que pode ficar com a pasta das partituras de contralto; vou falar com ele depois do ensaio desta quinta.
reply: Sr. Joaquim, queria dizer-lhe pessoalmente: vou sair do coro, e a missa de Todos os Santos, domingo 1 de novembro, será a minha última. É uma decisão pessoal e já está tomada. Até lá venho a todos os ensaios, e deixo a pasta das partituras de contralto com a Rita, que já disse que fica com ela. Foram oito anos muito bonitos, e nunca me vou esquecer de que foi o senhor que me ensinou a ler partituras. Obrigada por tudo.
note: Não é preciso explicar a razão: "é uma decisão pessoal" chega, e se ele insistir, repete-se com carinho, sem discutir fé.

situation: 我叫苏晴，在出版社做了六年编辑，下周五10月9日是最后一天，之后去读全日制研究生。部门今晚给我办欢送饭，主编陈老师让我说几句。六年前我连校样都不会看，是陈老师一页一页带我改出来的；手上的三本书已经交接给小林了。
reply: 谢谢大家今晚来给我送行。下周五是我在社里的最后一天，之后我要去读研了。六年前我刚来的时候连校样都不会看，是陈老师一页一页带着我改出来的，这个我会一直记着。手上的三本书已经跟小林交接好了，之后有什么问题也随时找我。以后社里出了新书，记得给我留一本！
note: 欢送会上的发言：不展开离开的理由，不翻旧账，说一件具体的感谢、交代好交接，再用一句轻松的话收尾。
